prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in can be helpful (won after adoption selection at +5.5% and photo upload at +3.3%), but placing sign-in after the adoption certificate severely hurt performance (-22.4%).
Desktop background notification prompts (+5.1%) and path selection helper hints (+3.3%) were helpful, but sound cue notifications, notification toggles, and desktop overlay hints showed no clear effect.
Copy updates and waiting screen progress/time displays consistently showed no clear effect.
Visual redesigns and layout changes showed no clear effect or caused severe negative drops (-17.2%) and guardrail rollbacks.
Predictions were frequently over-optimistic for non-winning tests, predicting up to +12.0% where no clear effect was measured.
Predictions underestimated several wins, such as sign-in reordering after photo upload (-8.0% predicted vs +3.3% measured) and path helper hints (+0.2% predicted vs +3.5% measured).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -10.9% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: +3.5% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +0.1% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: -2.2% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: -0.6% over 1 test(s)
- finish, hint: -0.4% over 1 test(s)
- finish, notification: -1.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: +3.2% over 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +0.4% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: -0.3% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -4.5% over 3 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 78.5%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 78.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 82.9%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.1%

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Stage Layout Pick Friend Experience: Redesign the Pick Friend screen using a stage layout featuring a pet preview component and stylized companion selection cards. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 60.9%. A stage layout creates a clearer visual focus for companion selection.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Mascot Placement Guide Screen: Add a new screen 'new_placement_guide' right before home intro that demonstrates how desktop pet positioning and interactions work. (why: Finish step drops to 64.8% and support received multiple emails from users confused about how to control or view their pet on desktop.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In After Pick Friend Selection: Move sign-in immediately after choosing a friend (pick_friend) and before photo upload or certificate confirmation. (why: Reordering sign-in after adoption selection improved conversion by 5.5% earlier; placing it right after pick_friend captures commitment before upload work.)
3: [choose_path, new_flow] Interactive Companion Archetype Quiz Flow: Insert a short quiz flow 'new_path_quiz' before choose_path to help users decide between preset pets and custom avatar creation. (why: Choose path takes a mean time of 514s (median 8s), showing that undecided users stall significantly before choosing a path.)
4: [adoption, incentive] Official Companion Stamp Incentive on Adoption Certificate: Add an official adoption verification badge and confirmation action card on the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9%; adding visual ownership validation increases motivation to complete certificate setup.)
5: [finish, hint] Desktop Control Shortcut Hint on Home Intro: Add a dedicated shortcut key hint on the home intro screen detailing desktop control keybindings. (why: Support receives frequent inquiries after onboarding from users confused about how to control, hide, or summon their desktop pet.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Notification Banner on Waiting Screen: Enable ready notifications and display a background generation readiness banner component on the waiting screen. (why: Home wait times average 201s median / 2336s mean, leading users to switch windows and drop out before pet creation finishes.)
7: [sign_in, copy] Pet Progress Cloud Backup Headline on Sign-In: Update sign-in headline and body copy to emphasize backing up pet progress to prevent data reset. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after re-authenticating; framing account sign-in around data protection builds trust.)
8: [home, wait_info] Mascot Animation Progress Display on Waiting Screen: Show progress status and an animated pet working mascot component on the waiting screen during generation. (why: The home stage features a long waiting period (201s median), causing drop-offs; active visual feedback reassures waiting users.)

scores.note: Visual redesigns on adoption historically show severe drops (-10.9%).
Both support emails and funnel point to finish drop-off, but adding a screen increases friction.
Reordering sign-in right after adoption selection was a proven win (+5.5%).
Inserting a new quiz flow adds significant friction to a step with an 8s median duration.
Targets the highest drop-off step (60.9%) with low-risk motivation card.
High evidence from support inquiries and low cost, though hint impact is generally mild.
Desktop background ready notifications consistently win (+3.2% to +5.1%).
Addresses support complaints, but copy updates consistently show no clear effect.
Waiting screen progress displays consistently showed no clear effect (+0.4%).
